events.title: Ordinals brings inscriptions to Bitcoin
events.summary: The Ordinals protocol introduced a method for tracking individual satoshis and inscribing data directly into Bitcoin transactions.
events.significance: Ordinals opened a new chapter of Bitcoin-native collectibles and blockspace demand.
events.notes: Pin exact first release / first inscription date before VERIFIED.

events.title: Kraken settles US staking-as-a-service charges
events.summary: Kraken agreed to discontinue its US staking-as-a-service program and pay $30 million to settle SEC charges.
events.significance: The settlement became a major regulatory turning point for centralized staking services in the United States.

events.title: USDC depegs during the Silicon Valley Bank crisis
events.summary: Circle disclosed that $3.3 billion of USDC reserves were held at Silicon Valley Bank. USDC traded below $1 during the bank-failure weekend before the peg recovered after regulators protected depositors.
events.significance: The episode showed that fiat-backed stablecoins inherit banking-system risk even when their on-chain contracts function normally.

events.title: Ethereum Shapella enables staking withdrawals
events.summary: The Shanghai-Capella upgrade activated at epoch 194,048 and enabled validators to withdraw staked ETH and rewards.
events.significance: Shapella completed a major piece of Ethereum's proof-of-stake transition by making validator stake withdrawable.

events.title: SEC sues Binance and Changpeng Zhao
events.summary: The SEC filed 13 charges against Binance entities and founder Changpeng Zhao alleging securities-law violations.
events.significance: The case became one of the largest US regulatory actions against a global crypto exchange.

events.title: SEC sues Coinbase
events.summary: The SEC charged Coinbase with operating as an unregistered securities exchange, broker and clearing agency and with an unregistered staking program.
events.significance: The lawsuit put the largest US-listed crypto exchange into a direct legal confrontation with the SEC over the regulatory status of crypto trading.

events.title: BlackRock files for the iShares Bitcoin Trust
events.summary: The iShares Bitcoin Trust filed its Form S-1 registration statement with the SEC on 15 June 2023.
events.significance: BlackRock's filing transformed the US spot Bitcoin ETF campaign by bringing the world's largest asset manager into the race.

events.title: Ripple receives a major court ruling in the SEC case
events.summary: Judge Analisa Torres issued a mixed summary-judgment ruling in SEC v. Ripple. Ripple summarizes the opinion as holding that XRP itself is not a security, while the transaction-specific securities analysis differed across categories of sales.
events.significance: The ruling became a major US precedent debate over how securities law applies to crypto tokens and token sales.
events.notes: Published copy should preserve the distinction between the token itself and specific transactions.

events.title: PayPal launches PYUSD
events.summary: PayPal launched PayPal USD (PYUSD), a dollar-backed ERC-20 stablecoin issued by Paxos.
events.significance: A global consumer payments company issuing its own stablecoin marked a major bridge between regulated payments and crypto-native settlement.

events.title: Base opens mainnet to everyone
events.summary: Coinbase-backed Base opened its OP Stack layer-2 mainnet to the public on 9 August 2023.
events.significance: Base connected a major centralized exchange's distribution directly to Ethereum layer-2 infrastructure and later became one of the largest L2 ecosystems.

events.title: Grayscale wins its court challenge against the SEC
events.summary: The D.C. Circuit granted Grayscale's petition for review and vacated the SEC's order denying conversion of GBTC to a Bitcoin ETF.
events.significance: The court victory materially changed the legal landscape for US spot Bitcoin ETP approval and preceded the January 2024 approvals.

sources.title: Grayscale — court victory press release / 8-K exhibit

events.title: BRC-20 creates fungible-token mania on Bitcoin
events.summary: The experimental BRC-20 standard used Ordinals inscriptions to create fungible-token conventions on Bitcoin.
events.significance: BRC-20 dramatically increased inscription activity and created a new speculative token market on Bitcoin.
events.notes: Pin original Domo announcement and first ORDI deployment before VERIFIED.

events.title: PEPE ignites a new meme-coin cycle
events.summary: PEPE rapidly became a major meme token during 2023 and helped restart speculative interest in meme coins after the 2022 bear market.
events.significance: The token helped establish a new meme-coin cycle that later expanded strongly across Ethereum and Solana.

events.title: BONK becomes a symbol of Solana's post-FTX revival
events.summary: BONK distributed tokens widely across the Solana community and became closely associated with renewed ecosystem attention after the FTX collapse.
events.significance: The meme coin became a cultural marker of Solana's unexpected recovery from its 2022 crisis.

events.title: Friend.tech creates a social-finance frenzy on Base
events.summary: Friend.tech popularized trading access keys linked to social-media accounts on Base.
events.significance: The brief boom became one of the earliest viral consumer-finance experiments on Base.

events.title: Solana stages a major post-FTX recovery
events.summary: Solana recovered strongly across price, developer activity, DeFi and consumer attention after being heavily damaged by its association with FTX and Alameda.
events.significance: The recovery changed the narrative from possible ecosystem failure to renewed competition with Ethereum and other smart-contract networks.

events.title: Sam Bankman-Fried is convicted
events.summary: A federal jury convicted Sam Bankman-Fried on seven fraud and conspiracy counts related to FTX and Alameda.
events.significance: The verdict closed the central criminal trial arising from FTX's collapse and established criminal responsibility for the fraud alleged by prosecutors.
